args.subject: Welcome to Blue Sparrow Tech, David!
args.body:
Hi David,

Welcome to Blue Sparrow Tech! I'm Emma Johnson, and I'm delighted to hear that you're joining our team next week in the marketing department.

We're excited to have you on board and look forward to working with you. If you have any questions before your first day — about the team, our processes, or anything at all — please don't hesitate to reach out. I'd be happy to help.

Looking forward to welcoming you properly!

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
